audit.whatIsWrong: The chart reads Skill / Volibear / Volibear / Volibear / Volibear / Volibear / Skill — Volibear owning five straight stages — while the entry's own early text says 'you are one of the best' at level 1 and 'Levels 4-5 you still own it', and Pantheon's win rate here is 52.35% over 766 games.
audit.why: This is the widest chart-versus-prose gap in my slice. Both layers agree with each other so I did not overrule them, but five stages contradicting the same file's prose and a favourable win rate is not something I can resolve from the kits.
audit.corrected: Left as found. Flagged in questionsForUser as the highest-priority chart in the slice.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns, and the level-6 spike said only that his R 'disables your tower and shields him'.
audit.why: Thundering Smash is 12s at rank 1, Frenzied Maul a flat 5s, Sky Splitter a flat 16s, Stormbringer 160s at rank 1. Stormbringer grants bonus health rather than a shield.
audit.corrected: All four written into early, mid, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5]; Stormbringer's bonus health corrected in whys[4] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings call his stun 'E hand-of-the-god' — 'his E hand-of-the-god stun locks you for the kill', 'Watch his E stun', 'Land E hand-of-the-god to lock you down'. Volibear's E is Sky Splitter, a lightning bolt that slows and shields him. The stun is Thundering Smash, his Q.
audit.why: Riot: Thundering Smash (Q, 12s) 'gains speed towards enemies, Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks'; Sky Splitter (E, 16s) 'summons a lightning bolt at a location, dealing damage and Slowing enemies while granting Volibear a Shield if he's inside the blast radius'. A player watching his E for a stun is watching the wrong ability on the wrong cooldown, and misses that Sky Splitter only shields him when he stands in his own blast — which is a positioning tell.
audit.corrected: Thundering Smash named as the Q stun with its 12s and its auto reset; Sky Splitter named as the E bolt with its shield condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Frenzied Maul is called 'his W bite' but the mechanic that makes it a heal is never stated.
audit.why: Riot: 'Volibear damages an enemy, applying on-hit effects and marking them. Casting this ability again on the same target deals bonus damage and Heals Volibear.' The heal requires a SECOND cast into the same target. That converts 'don't let him heal' into a concrete instruction: break off or reposition after the first maul and the heal never happens.
audit.corrected: Written into early, mid, whys[2], whys[3], spikes[1] and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said Thundering Smash cancels Aegis Assault or that it is an auto reset.
audit.why: Thundering Smash stuns, and Aegis Assault is a channel — the stun ends it. It is also an attack reset, so the charge-up is the step-back cue rather than the cast. Both are flagged for this pairing in _missing-interactions.
audit.corrected: Written into early, mid, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and report[5].

audit.whatIsWrong: The Relentless Storm is never named and his attack-speed scaling is never mentioned.
audit.why: His passive grants attack speed and eventually adds bonus magic damage to his attacks, and Frenzied Maul applies on-hit effects — so his output scales with attack speed and part of it is magic damage. Armour alone reads the fight wrong, which _missing-interactions flags for this pairing.

edits.before: Volibear is a weak, dash-less level 1 and you are one of the best — open with point-and-click W to stun him and a Q tap, and he has nothing to answer. At 2 you spike into your all-in; at 3 with E online you can hold the directional block toward his W bite so the slow and damage just don't land, then W-stun in and Q-burst. Don't let him free-stack HP and W-heal off minions; every level you trade is a level his sustain hasn't come online.
edits.after: Volibear is a weak, dash-less level 1 and you are one of the best — open with point-and-click Shield Vault and a Comet Spear tap, and he has nothing to answer. At 2 you spike into your all-in. Learn the slots: Thundering Smash (Q, 12s at rank 1) is the stun, it resets his auto, and it cancels Aegis Assault, so the charge-up is your cue to step back. Frenzied Maul (W, 5s) only heals on the second cast into the same target.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you still own it — empowered-Q poke chunks him and your E eats his W bite, so keep forcing short W-Q trades and disengage with E before his heal ticks. At 6 it evens out: his R disables your tower and shields him for a brawl, while your Grand Starfall is better spent roaming than dueling, so press your lead elsewhere on the map. Watch his E stun — if it lands while you're committed, his W heal turns your burst into a losing fight.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you still own it — empowered-Q poke chunks him, so keep forcing short trades and leave before the second Frenzied Maul lands its heal. Sky Splitter (E, 16s) is the lightning bolt: it slows you and shields him only when he stands in his own blast. At 6 it evens out: Stormbringer disables your tower and gives him bonus health for the brawl, while Grand Starfall is better spent roaming than dueling here.

edits.before: This is his game now. Past 2 items Volibear is a tanky diver — his W bite heals through your damage, his E hand-of-the-god stun locks you for the kill, and your low base stats and lack of sustain mean you melt once your burst is on cooldown. Don't try to 1v1 him in the side lane; group, use Grand Starfall to flank squishies, and rely on the lead you built early because raw scaling has flipped against you.
edits.after: This is his game now. Past 2 items Volibear is a tanky diver — Frenzied Maul heals through your damage on every second cast, Thundering Smash stuns you for the kill, and The Relentless Storm ramps his attack speed, so armour alone reads the fight wrong. Don't try to 1v1 him in the side lane; group, use Grand Starfall to flank squishies, and rely on the lead you built early.

notes: Volibear's stun is on the wrong ability in three places. The entry calls it 'his E hand-of-the-god stun' — that is pre-rework Volibear flavour attached to the wrong slot. Sky Splitter is his E, a lightning bolt that slows and shields him only if he is standing in his own blast radius; the stun is Thundering Smash, his Q, on 12 seconds at rank 1. So the page has the player watching the wrong ability on the wrong cooldown, and it also loses the Sky Splitter positioning tell. Second, the entry says 'his W bite heals through your damage' without ever stating the condition: Frenzied Maul heals only when he casts it a SECOND time into the same target. That turns a vague warning into an instruction — break the pattern after the first maul and there is no heal. Also added: Thundering Smash is an auto reset that cancels Aegis Assault (both flagged in _missing-interactions), and The Relentless Storm's attack-speed ramp, which means armour alone misreads his damage. CHART, and this is the one I would most like a human answer on: both layers give Volibear five consecutive stages including levels 2 through 6, while the same entry's prose says Pantheon owns levels 1-3 and 'still owns it' at 4-5, and Pantheon wins this matchup 52.35%. I did not touch it.
